notes.title: Byte The Bullet - Dev Explanation!
notes.content:
Hello! Lion Ant Games has an important message for all followers! Discover more about Byte The Bullet in this new video!

[previewyoutube=p3yOMfwjfHs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Hurry up! Byte The Bullet is now on sale on Steam with a 10% discount until October 3rd![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1888380?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamevent&utm_medium=steam

notes.title: Special streaming of Byte The Bullet at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Don't miss the special streaming event for the new Steam Next Fest! Byte The Bullet is an action-platformer game full of secrets and easter eggs!

Play the demo now on Steam Next Fest and liberate the Video Card to bring color back to the game. Will you find the path to a corrupted RAM level?

Don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1888380?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamfest&utm_medium=steamevent
